div.head: Quadr II Praef 4
div.ab: Sed hoc tantis eam promotionibus elicit, quod, cum omni forinseca perturbatione sit libera, tantis gaudiorum uoluptatibus euehatur — sicut miseranda mortalium condicio est, malo scilicet acclinis et lapsui prona —: intestinis animi sedicionibus et ceco nouorum molimine semper infrendit.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 542 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: But this it draws forth [?] from such great advancements, that, since it is free of all outside disturbance, it is carried away by such pleasures of joys — as the pitiable condition of mortals is, inclined namely to evil and prone to falling —: it is always gnashing its teeth with internal seditions of the mind and the blind striving after new things.
